About Us

From Director's Desk

At The 9th Corner, design is more than just creating spaces—it’s about shaping experiences. Every project we undertake is a journey of collaboration, creativity, and craftsmanship. From residences that feel like sanctuaries, to commercial spaces that inspire productivity, to furniture that becomes timeless accents—we believe great design lies in the details. Our approach blends functionality with aesthetics, innovation with tradition, and vision with execution. In past 22 years since when the company was incorporated,As the director, my commitment is to ensure that each space we design tells a story—your story. With a team of passionate designers and architects, we strive to transform ideas into spaces that reflect identity, purpose, and beauty. We look forward to creating spaces that inspire, elevate, and endure.
-Rahuul Guptaa
